highlights.label: 极小极大子空间法｜历史残差统一全局与局部收敛
highlights.text: 四族 Jacobian-free 共轭梯度型方向经角度与尺度保护后，可用投影线搜索或固定步长求解单调方程；在无需强单调性的条件下获得全局收敛，并在局部正则时达到 R-线性收敛。

highlights.label: 延迟安全寻优｜预测误差进入 CLF–CBF 证书
highlights.text: SANES 从延迟的目标与安全测量预测当前梯度、Hessian 和障碍信息，再用鲁棒 QP 同时实现 Newton 寻优与硬安全约束；理论把估计误差、预测误差和探测振荡分别纳入收敛与安全界。

papers.title: Subspace methods for min-max problems
papers.abstract: This paper introduces four groups of subspace methods for nonlinear monotone equations, with applications to large-scale machine learning problems. The methods use Jacobian-free subspace ({\tt JFS}) directions of conjugate-gradient type, combined with either fixed step sizes or variable step sizes generated by the projected method of Solodov and Svaiter. To ensure convergence independently of the specific algebraic form of the subspace directions, we impose an angle condition together with an explicit scaling rule controlling the effective search directions. Under monotonicity and Lipschitz continuity of the operator, we establish global convergence for both the line-search and fixed-step frameworks, as well as a best-iterate residual rate $O(\ell^{-1/2})$. Under a local error bound, the distance to the solution set satisfies the sharper decay $o(\ell^{-1/2})$. If the operator is continuously differentiable and its Jacobian is nonsingular at a solution, the required local error bound and local isolation follow, yielding $R$-linear local convergence. The residual sequence then converges geometrically and hence satisfies the last-iterate rate $o(\ell^{-1})$, without strong monotonicity. We also derive iteration and residual-evaluation complexity bounds: $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ for the baseline best-iterate guarantee and $O(\log(\varepsilon^{-1}))$ in the local linear regime, together with a uniform bound on backtracking residual evaluations. Under additional asymptotic assumptions, the proposed {\tt JFS} directions and several classical update directions admit related optimistic gradient descent--ascent ({\texttt OGDA})-type residual--memory representations. Numerical experiments illustrate the robustness and efficiency of the methods on representative min--max problems.
papers.summary: 可微凸–凹极小极大问题的一阶条件可写成单调非线性方程，但共轭梯度型子空间方向可能无界，现有分析也常依赖具体更新公式。该文提出 PLS-S 与 PF-S 框架：四族 Jacobian-free 方向由当前残差、历史方向、残差差分和位移组合，再经尺度规则与锐角保护形成有效方向；试探点定义包含解集的分离半空间，算法用精确投影配合 Solodov–Svaiter 线搜索或固定步长更新。在解集非空、算子单调且 Lipschitz 时，两种实现全局收敛，精确投影版本的最佳残差为 $O(\ell^{-1/2})$；局部误差界把解集距离提高到 $o(\ell^{-1/2})$，若极限解处 Jacobian 非奇异，则无需强单调性也得到迭代点局部 R-线性收敛及几何残差衰减。相应全局复杂度为 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$，局部线性区为 $O(\log \varepsilon^{-1})$，并有每步回溯残差评估上界。
papers.reason: 最值得阅读的是框架把历史残差与方向的具体代数形式同收敛证明解耦：只要缩放后的方向满足统一角度和尺度条件，投影几何就可提供 Fejér 单调性、全局保证与局部加速。这为设计利用多步信息的极小极大算法提供了可复用的安全接口；同时，文中对 MARL、鲁棒对抗学习和 GAN 单调测试问题的实验表明代表性 PLS-S 变体在残差评估上明显优于 OGDA 与外梯度。应注意结论依赖单调性与 Lipschitz 条件，不能直接外推到一般非凸–非凹博弈。

papers.title: Safe Newton-Based Extremum Seeking for Static Maps with Delayed Output Measurements
papers.abstract: This work presents a delayed safe Newton-based extremum seeking (SANES) framework for minimizing an unknown static map subject to an unknown safety constraint. The objective and safety measurements are assumed to be affected by the same constant time delay. To compensate for delayed measurements, a model-free predictor is developed to construct the quantities required for optimization, including the nominal Newton-based extremum-seeking control input and the gradient information used to formulate control Lyapunov function (CLF) and control barrier function (CBF) conditions. Robust CLF--CBF quadratic programs (QPs), subject to parameter-update constraints, are then formulated to account explicitly for derivative-estimation and prediction errors. For the delay-free case, robustness margins are derived from bounds on the extremum-seeking estimation errors, whereas for the delayed case, the margins incorporate both estimation and prediction errors. Practical stability of the nominal Newton-based extremum-seeking dynamics is established directly through a Lyapunov analysis, thereby providing convergence guarantees over the admissible parameter set without relying exclusively on local averaging arguments. Robust CLF and CBF conditions are subsequently derived to establish practical convergence and forward invariance of a robust subset of the prescribed safe set. A numerical case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed SANES framework in achieving constrained optimization despite unknown objective and safety maps and delayed measurements.
papers.summary: 模型未知的实时极值寻优若同时依赖延迟的目标值和安全测量，过去时刻的障碍证书不能直接保证当前位置安全。该文提出安全 Newton 极值寻优 SANES：探测与解调滤波从标量测量估计目标梯度、Hessian 及安全梯度；再利用一个延迟区间内慢变量的已知位移构造当前目标梯度、Hessian、障碍值与障碍梯度的一阶预测，并用 Riccati 型更新避免直接求逆。随后一个鲁棒 CLF–CBF QP 在贴近预测 Newton 方向的同时，把收敛约束设为可松弛项，把安全与参数更新界保留为硬约束。对紧凸参数域上的三次连续可微强凸目标、已知共同常延迟、满足时间尺度分离和非共振的探测信号，以及联合可行且足够小的估计/预测误差，作者证明参数最终进入显式邻域，并保持鲁棒安全子集前向不变；QP 还具有唯一解。
papers.reason: 这项工作的关键价值是正面处理“延迟使安全证书过时”这一安全关键优化难点，而不是只给寻优器加一个现成安全滤波器。预测误差、梯度估计误差和持续探测振荡分别进入 CLF 下降界、CBF 鲁棒裕量与最终邻域，便于判断延迟、探测幅值和安全缓冲之间的取舍。推荐关注其模型自由预测器与硬安全/软收敛 QP 的接口；当前验证主要是一项源寻优避障算例，且理论依赖共同已知常延迟、强凸目标和安全约束可行性。
